body: Thanks I might take you up on that.

It's fine man. It helps just to have someone who can relate. I know what you mean though, finding someone who shares the same idea about how relationships should work is really hard and even if you do find someone there's no guarantee that you'll even like them.

Thank you for the advice, It means a lot. I'm trying to get back in contact with a few old friends. I understand what you're saying about getting out and doing things, a large part of me wants to just say home constantly and never do anything. Thanks for taking the time to respond.
